notes.macArch: The macOS build is 32-bit only (i386); Apple silicon cannot run it, so GameLib installs the Windows build. Mach-O header read of the Mac depot's main binary in spike 045 (CEG census, macarch.json), recorded 2026-10-27 (quick 261027-gtd). The Mac depot names its main binary 'Hitman Sniper Challenge' (a Feral packaging quirk), so the binary was picked by size.
notes.drm: The Windows build's HMA.exe is a Steam CEG executable (EDepotFileFlag.CustomExecutable in the public depot manifest, spike 045). CEG needs a genuine Windows Steam client, so GameLib routes this title to bottled Steam before any download (quick 261027-gtd).
